zh-CN.title: 主角登场，收集你的 BGM
items: 空间管理员可申领一个月的主角登场活动，广场横幅直达专属按键器
通过公开发言、评论和点赞收集 12 首 BGM，最快需 15 个活跃日集齐
支持六键装配和自动／手动登场，音效默认关闭，保留旧版音频展示

en.title: Make an entrance with your BGM
items: Space administrators can launch a month-long event with a Square banner and personal music keychain
Collect 12 tracks through public posts, comments and likes, with at least 15 active days to complete
Equip six keys and choose automatic or manual entrances; sounds are off by default and legacy audio remains supported
